On the Water of Our Lord’s Baptisme

Richard Crashaw (c. 1613–1649)

E
ACH
 blest drop on each blest limme
Is wash’t itselfe in washing Him:
’Tis a gemme while it stayes here;
While it falls hence ’tis a teare.
